en.title: Share your DBS check result
en.h1: What you need to do now
en.bullet4: send the email we have just sent you, to the person you want to see your result
en.bullet5: give the share code to the person you want to see your result
en.p7: if you have not received the email or you cannot find it. For your security you must send the share code separately to the email, for example by text message.
en.insetText: You can view all the share codes you generate on the ‘Manage Share Codes’ tab. You can also cancel any unused share codes.

cy.title: Rhannwch ganlyniad eich gwiriad DBS
cy.bullet3: yn ddilys am 21 diwrnod yn unig
cy.h1: Beth sydd angen i chi ei wneud nawr
cy.bullet4: anfon yr e-bost rydym newydd ei anfon atoch, at y person rydych am iddo weld eich canlyniad
cy.bullet5: rhoi'r cod rhannu i'r person rydych chi am iddo weld eich canlyniad
cy.p7: os nad ydych wedi derbyn yr e-bost neu os na allwch ddod o hyd iddo. Er eich diogelwch mae'n rhaid i chi anfon y cod rhannu ar wahân i'r e-bost, er enghraifft trwy neges destun.
cy.insetText: Gallwch weld yr holl godau rhannu rydych yn eu cynhyrchu ar y tab ‘Rheoli codau rhannu’. Gallwch hefyd ganslo unrhyw godau rhannu nas defnyddiwyd.
